description: Canonical public install commands. Both website/assets/js/install.js and tests/test_website.py read this file so the website cannot drift from the fixed install contract. Do not change the one-liner commands without updating the PROMETHEUS_MVP_RECOVERY_PROMPT contract.

tabs.label: Linux
tabs.manual:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FeverDream-dev/Prometheus/main/install.sh -o install.sh
less install.sh
sh install.sh
